register_dataset: register a single COCO DensePose dataset with DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog using a CocoDatasetInfo object
register_datasets: register multiple COCO DensePose datasets at once by passing an iterable of CocoDatasetInfo objects
load_coco_json: load COCO format annotations from a JSON file and return dataset records with image and annotation data
get_metadata: get DensePose metadata dictionary containing UV symmetry transforms and SMPL subdivision file paths
create_video_frame_mapping: create a video frame to file name mapping for datasets containing video frame information
